consequences.explanation: The shared runner must preserve the distinction among reading, instruction inspection, authorization and observed delivery.

payload.decision: Expose supported Projector workflows through one versioned discriminated operation request/result contract. The installed JavaScript runner loads the packaged TypeScript services in-process, derives package identity from the packaged root manifest, checks readiness and shared operation access inside every operation, propagates the caller AbortSignal, and reports structured unavailable and recovery actions. Capability discovery is derived from the registered operation handlers, bounded readiness metadata and directly observed host capabilities; a registered handler establishes reachability only and cannot establish host enforcement or operational readiness. Skills and hooks call this runner. Markdown explains the contract but typed schemas and handlers own it. Do not preserve wrapper-to-CLI subprocess chains, standalone MCP delivery, or task17 host dispatch merely for obsolete names. Preserve an old adapter only when a current consumer and requirement need it.
payload.title: Use one bundled JavaScript operation runner
